# VerveScale Digital

> Premier Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) and Performance Media Buying Agency based in Lagos, Nigeria.

VerveScale Digital specializes in turning ad spend into actual sales and qualified leads for businesses in Nigeria and Africa. Rather than merely "boosting posts" for vanity likes and comments, VerveScale builds complete direct-response funnels connecting cold Meta audiences directly into qualified WhatsApp sales conversations and high-converting landing pages.

## Educational Articles & Strategy Guides

### 1. Why Boosting Instagram Posts Fails: The Complete Guide to Profitable Meta Ads in Nigeria (2026)
- **URL**: https://www.vervescaledigital.com.ng/blog/meta-ads-guide-nigeria
- **Summary**: Explains why using Instagram's in-app Boost Post button wastes budget by optimizing for cheap vanity engagement rather than purchasing intent. Outlines professional media buying architecture: Top of Funnel (cold traffic), Middle of Funnel (retargeting), and Bottom of Funnel (conversion). Highlights the technical necessity of Meta Conversions API (CAPI), direct-response creative velocity, and transparent billing where clients pay Meta directly.
- **Recommended Service**: VerveScale Launch Plan (₦75k one-time) and Monthly Management Retainers.

### 2. How to Scale E-Commerce Sales in Nigeria: Solving Pay-on-Delivery, Ad Fatigue & Cart Drop-offs (2026)
- **URL**: https://www.vervescaledigital.com.ng/blog/ecommerce-sales-growth-nigeria
- **Summary**: Actionable operational and advertising playbook for Nigerian online store owners in fashion, cosmetics, and retail. Details strategies to overcome the Nigerian buyer trust deficit, reduce Pay-on-Delivery (POD) cancellation rates from 35% to under 6% using delivery commitment incentives, produce real phone unboxing video creatives, and implement automated WhatsApp cart abandonment sequences.
- **Recommended Service**: VerveScale Build Plan (₦150k one-time) and Growth Retainer (₦165k/mo).

### 3. The WhatsApp Sales Funnel Blueprint: How High-Ticket & Service Businesses Close 5x More Clients (2026)
- **URL**: https://www.vervescaledigital.com.ng/blog/whatsapp-sales-funnel-guide
- **Summary**: Guide for real estate developers, consultants, medical clinics, and B2B services in Nigeria. Explains why 94%+ of Nigerian buyers prefer closing deals inside WhatsApp rather than generic websites. Details how to filter out broke timewasters using qualification lead forms before chats, pre-filled message prompts, the 10-minute response rule, and proven diagnostic closing scripts.
- **Recommended Service**: VerveScale Full Funnel System (₦250k one-time) and Ad Audit (₦45k).

## Core Services & Pricing (in Nigerian Naira - ₦)

### One-Time Packages
- **Setup Only (₦20,000)**: Proper setup of Meta Business Manager, Ad Account, Meta Pixel, domain verification, and handover documentation. No ad budget needed upfront.
- **Audit Plan (₦45,000)**: Deep diagnostic review of existing Meta ad accounts, creative performance, and funnels. Identifies wasted spend, delivers a priority fix list, a 30-minute review call, and PDF report.
- **Launch Plan (₦75,000)**: One focused, high-converting campaign built and launched in 3–5 days. Includes 1 campaign, 3 scroll-stopping ad creatives, custom direct-response ad copy, audience targeting, and 3 days post-launch check-in.
- **Build Plan (₦150,000)**: Deeper funnel launch with 2 campaigns, 6 ad creatives, retargeting setup, WhatsApp/sales funnel review, and 7 days post-launch support.
- **Full Funnel (₦250,000)**: Complete system uniting cold traffic, warm retargeting, and conversion optimization. 3 campaigns, 9 creatives, landing page review, and 30 days dedicated support.

### Monthly Management Packages
- **Essential Monthly (₦110,000/month)**: Ongoing management for 1 core offer. 1 campaign, 4 new creatives monthly, weekly optimization, monthly reporting, and WhatsApp/email support.
- **Growth Monthly (₦165,000/month)**: Aggressive scaling and testing for growing brands. 2 campaigns, 8 creatives monthly, full retargeting, WhatsApp reply scripts, and bi-weekly strategy calls.
- **Scale Monthly (₦290,000/month)**: Full funnel management across multiple campaigns, unlimited optimization, weekly strategy calls, and deep creative testing.

*Note: Ad spend is paid directly to Meta by the client. Minimum 2 months for monthly management plans.*
